remarks: *Seller relocating* Welcome to 6940 Versailles Road! This well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of historic charm, modern comfort, and peaceful country living, all while being just minutes from Lake Erie, 18 Mile Creek, local parks, shopping, and major routes. Inside, you'll find a bright and inviting layout featuring a spacious eat-in kitchen, a formal dining room perfect for entertaining, and a generous living room with a cozy fireplace. A sun-filled three-season room overlooks the private wooded backyard, creating the perfect space to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day. A full basement provides ample storage and additional potential. Step outside to enjoy the expansive wooded lot featuring, a beautiful patio, welcoming front porch, storage shed, and concrete/paver driveway. Whether you're entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing in the tranquil surroundings, this property offers something for everyone!
